requirements.criterion: Consequential claims have exact directly inspected locators or explicit lower-confidence/inaccessible primary status; attribution, interpretation, unknowns and project invention remain distinct.

requirements.criterion: Occurrence and revelation/publication orders separately recorded across represented existing dossier range, with supported time uncertainty and no invented calendar.
requirements.evidence: Each EVENTS ledger and source/reader chronology references.

requirements.criterion: Participant goals/means, material/institutional support, prerequisite effects, actual consequences and dependent versus independent causes are concrete; disturbance effects labeled counterfactual proposals.
requirements.evidence: EVENTS dependency rows/graph, EXPANSIONS and explicit source qualifications.

requirements.criterion: Actor knowledge uses witnessed/communicated/remembered channels and dates/order, preserving mistaken belief, reader foreknowledge, withheld facts and discarded-history distinction.
requirements.evidence: KNOWLEDGE rows joined to events/claims/source observers.

requirements.criterion: Continuity/media conflicts, source exceptions and unsupported futures remain qualified; no silent WN/LN/anime/manga/IF/fan merge.

Source-grounded expansions retain existing idea IDs, before/during/after states, real first actions, ordinary and intervention routes, NPC-held means and downstream consequences; all are proposals unless independently authorized.
requirements.evidence: EXPANSIONS rows, prior-owner links and exact source joins.

requirements.criterion: Whole represented dossier range accounted for, available assigned material reviewed to declared depth; remaining inaccessible primary ranges and future source/detail tasks exact, not scope shrunk to samples.
requirements.evidence: COVERAGE/REMAINING manifests, explicit range accounting and acquisition alternatives.

requirements.criterion: Actual artifacts inspected; JSON/unique IDs/local references/source hashes/private ignore/privacy checks and semantic/source review passed within their real scope.
requirements.evidence: Per-world validation plus coordinator cross-checks, independent review and final VALIDATION.json.

requirements.criterion: Five checked returns integrated into public-safe coverage/report and private synthesis, then delivered via safe path/status/source limits only to relevant authorized current project GM/implementation chats.
requirements.evidence: Final REPORT/private SYNTHESIS/DISPATCH/CHECKPOINT and actual delivery receipts.

runtimeAcceptance: Not assigned; all future baseline/disturbance/failure/delayed-arrival/knowledge/save cases remain explicitly unrun in this research tranche.
completionRule: Every requirement assessed against actual artifacts for all five worlds; remaining inaccessible primaries qualify completed range but never establish full manga/series read. Required unfinished available work cannot be waived.
